claim_scope: Preset-scoped complete-wet integration ledger consumed by tools/publish_coverage.py. Each record states what one committed integration run of ONE corpus preset (bank/path/blob identity) establishes, under a declared qualification scope (original or adapted), pinning the normalized graph, patch image, oracle fixture, event sequence, fidelity policy and integrated evidence by full sha256 (re-hashed at run time; mismatch -> STALE). Verification statuses use the PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED/NO_VERDICT/STALE vocabulary. Nothing here is a support, fidelity, musical-quality or hardware claim; no record in this file is PASS. Synthetic records are control fixtures only and are refused in a published run.
record_rules: a record qualifies only the preset whose bank, path and blob_sha1 it names
normalized_graph_sha256 is compiler/compile.py::graph_sha256 of the corpus graph
fx_placement_order lists required effect instances in slot order as slot:role:class
fidelity_policy must equal the fidelity_freeze gate's frozen_policy pin; null while #12 is open
adapted-scope records disclose their adaptation and never authorize original support
a measured FAIL against [PROPOSED] budgets is recorded as NO_VERDICT (leaf-ledger convention) and the measurement named in the note

records.adaptation: finding F-1: the voice stage is the pinned engine's own all-off DRY bus of the same preset+sequence (declared voice-stage boundary), not the original voice; the wet path downstream of it is the original Reverb 1 @ send2
